wineGlass.evidenceText: The three ordered Berlin searches returned public menus with red wine glasses at 0.10 L, 0.20 L, or 0.25 L, and other menus without a qualifying standard-glass volume. No single returned public menu supplied at least three standard dry-red wines at 125–175 ml; no fallback, retry, or alternate search was used.
